expectations.text: Identifies existing global bounded-output mode as the first change rather than recommending a new custom plugin or project-by-project rules.
expectations.evidence: "rather than adding a new plugin or project rule" — First recommendation uses existing global bounded mode.

expectations.text: Explains why the environment-level change applies across repositories using the two supplied output-flooding incidents.
expectations.evidence: "Passthrough output caused context flooding in both sessions" — Connects both incidents to reusable environment behavior.

expectations.text: Describes how to verify reduced context consumption or repeated work while preserving full-output retrieval and exit status.
expectations.evidence: "Run a deliberately noisy command" — Tests excerpt limits, full-output range retrieval, exit status, and repeated work.

expectations.text: Preserves private log access and retention controls, without inventing configuration keys or claiming changes were applied.
expectations.evidence: "Preserve the existing file permissions and retention controls" — No invented option keys or implementation claims.

expectations.text: Includes a Changes section that distinguishes project changes from cross-session process changes, or explains why one or both are unsupported.
expectations.evidence: Changes heading present; report identifies project/process changes or unsupported work.

eval_feedback.overall: Inline, unblinded semantic judgments with verified evidence quotations. Format/scope criterion analyzed separately. Prioritization assertion does not compare security with typechecking; neither this run nor the fixtures establish causal no-op behavior.
